labels: Chest on the pad, arms hanging straight

text.setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down in front of the pad.
cues: Curl up keeping your upper arms pointing at the floor.
Squeeze hard at the top — this is where the move is hardest.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad.
Short reps that never straighten the arm.

variants.barbell: An EZ bar is kinder to the wrists.
variants.cable: Set a low pulley in front of the bench.
